rationale: No supported optimization applies without weakening coverage or adding unsupported changes. The workflow already enables the uv dependency cache via `astral-sh/setup-uv@v10.3.3` with `enable-cache: true`, which is an equivalent dependency-download cache; P-LIT-GHA-CACHE lists "An equivalent cache already exists" as a contraindication, and the measured pip-cache experiment (experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2) was applied to a workflow using setup-python without caching, unlike this one. Stale-run cancellation is already present via `concurrency.cancel-in-progress: true` (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE already satisfied). There is no matrix for fail-fast, no Bazel build for Bazel patterns, and this is a docs/build-and-deploy workflow where test/build selection would reduce required coverage. The per-run `apt-get install pandoc` is not covered by any supported evidence pattern, and the deployment step must retain its required checks and secret.
